align.description: an item pronounces on settledness instead of describing — 'settled', 'finalized', 'canon', or the inverse hedges ('deliberately open', 'expected to evolve', 'not dictated here'); the doctrine is specificity-per-confidence: describe the shape at the specificity current understanding supports, and leave flux unstated — it is the ambient condition of everything here, so restating it in either direction adds status where only description belongs. Scope: the agenda items and design prose that describes a specific shape. This does NOT apply to the project's deliberate framing or manifesto — the README's stated identity (the epigraph 'Nothing is canon. Everything can evolve.', the experimental-project NOTE, 'a starting point, not a canon') is intentional authorial voice establishing the project's character and frame once, not per-item status hedging, and is never a finding; the evolving/experimental nature stated as the project's stance is description of what the project IS, not a settledness pronouncement to flag
